== Chapter 1 - Realities Collide ==
=== 1. ''A Beast to Start'' ===
==== Part 1 ====
* '''[[Marissa Faireborn]]''': ''Teletraan's scanners have detected a valuable cache of resources.''
* ''While we search for Megatron we should continue to upgrade our squad using what we find on our missions.''

==== Part 2 ====
* '''[[Optimus Prime]]''': ''It seems every bot here has been programmed to do one thing... fight!''
* '''Marissa''': ''Preliminary readings from Teletraan corroborate your assessment.''
* ''Teletraan confirms there are numerous beings of Cybertronian descent in the area, and all show traces of Dark Energon.''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Dark Energon?! The path to our survival grows more perilous indeed.''

==== Part 3 ====
* '''[[Rhinox]]''': ''I don't know who you are, but I'd advise to slow your roll.''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Stranger, we mean you no harm. We are simply on a mission to gather resources to repair our ship.''
* '''Rhinox''': ''Oh yeah? Well, we got a problem, friend. Resources are scarce and everyone wants 'em.''
* ''You want ''mine''? You're gonna have to talk to my little friends.''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Friends?''
* '''Rhinox''': {{RedText|Yeah, I like to call them the Chainguns of Doom!}}

'''<u>2. A Slow Learner</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Marissa''': ''Teletraan has plotted two possible courses for the next cache of resources. One path appears to contain formidable combatants likely protecting items of value.''

'''[[Starscream]]''': ''Or you can take the other "easier" path. Demise at my hands await you either way you choose.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Starscream! Don't you ever learn?''

'''Starscream''': ''Oh, I've learned lots Autofool! I've learned that the power of Ore-13 has enabled me to do what'' ''Megatron has failed to do time and again...crush you.''

Part 2: 

'''[[Ratchet]]''': ''Commander, We've found repair kits on this planet that could help our cause. I added one to your inventory prior to the mission. If needed, I suggest using it before your next battle.''

'''Starscream''':  ''Yes, "Commander", listen to your antiquated medical officer, but it won't matter. When I'm done with you, Ratchet's famed sick bay will be your FINAL destination!''

'''<u>3. Me Have Mod</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Marissa''': ''Commander, [[Prowl]] just got back from surveying the terrain ahead. There's a brewing dust storm of Beta 4'' ''proportions ahead. Through the dust he thought he saw what appeared to be a dinobot.''

'''[[Grimlock]]''': '''''Me no Dinobot. Me Grimlock! King Dinobot!!!'''''

Prowl: Uh-oh, things just took a turn for the dimwitted.

'''Grimlock''': '''''Dumbwhatted? What you mean?! Me smash you...when me ready!'''''

Part 2: 

'''Prowl''': ''I have more intel on Grimlock. He's up ahead, and from what I can gather, he is preparing some sort of object to strengthen his defenses.''

'''Grimlock''': '''''BAAAAAAH!!! Prowl talk too much! But, him right. Me have secret for fight. Me big smart!'''''

'''Prowl''': ''Commander, you take care of the task at hand. I'll investigate his "secret" and report back.''

Part 3: 

'''Prowl''': ''I've got some bad news. King Dimlock has somehow rigged a device that modifies his powers.''

'''Grimlock''': '''''That's right! Me told you me no bozo! Me have mod. You a fleshie with weak bots! BAH! You lose!'''''

'''Prowl''': ''Commander, you distract him in battle. I'll see what I can do about getting this "Mod" tech back to the base for analysis. It could be of use someday.''

'''<u>4. Good Cop Bad Cop</u>'''

Part 1: 

'''Optimus Prime''': ''The urgency of our mission grows great. Teletraan's analysis of our hostile encounters suggest my worst fears my be true.''

''Dark Energon and advanced alien technology are likely behind this madness that has befallen us.''

'''[[Barricade]]''': ''Halt! Are you LadiesMan217?''

'''''I said, are you LADIESMAN217?!'''''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''As I said, madness surrounds us. Commander, roll out!''

Part 2:

'''Prowl''': ''We were able to get a read out on that bot you met back there...the Ladiesman217 Decepticon with more than one screw loose.''

''Teletraan says he's from a parallel reality. And get this, his alt form is a cop car.''

'''Barricade''': ''That's POLICE CAR! I don't know who you are, but I detect Autobot. Let me duly notify you that my job is to make Autobots cease to function...permanently. Proceed if you dare.''

Part 3:

'''Prowl''': ''We're here, It's good cop vs bad cop time.''

'''Barricade''': ''Let me assure you, step a foot forward and it will be bad cop vs dead cop time. And, there's only one bad cop here.''

'''<u>5. The Way Of The Blade</u>'''

Part 1: 

'''[[Windblade]]''': ''This path is not yours to take.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Windblade! We have fought many battles as allies...as friends. What possesses you?''

'''Windblade''': ''It is true I recognize you, Prime. But, here is this insufferable planet, I am compelled to serve a new master - a master that has taught me the ways of...Metallikato!''

'''[[Bludgeon]]''': ''Fools! Enough with the discourse. Windblade, show them the way of the blade!''

Part 2:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Strangers, friends, foes... they all act deranged.''

''Windblade, Grimlock, Bumblebee...it would take an innate knowledge of Cybertronian physiology and mechanics to turn these sparks so dark.''

'''Marissa''': ''Teletraan occurs. The research points towards a technology that is Cybertronian in origin.''

Part 3: 

'''Windblade''': ''Step no further, The first fight was a warning. This will be an ending.''

'''Bludgeon''': ''Windblade! Stand down. You are but a student. Let a master teach them the power of the One True Path.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Decepticon, I respect your dedication to your art. But it is one of darkness. Commander, go forth and show him the light, so that we may find the answers we seek.''

'''<u>6. Hail Who?</u>'''

'''Marissa''': ''We ran diagnostics on the "Mod" Grimlock was using. Teletraan has confirmed what you suspected...The Quintessons are behind it's creation.''

''Mods exist to enhance certain properties of the bot it is connected to.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''As I surmised, our creators - The Quintessons. They would have the capability and desire to inflict a planet such as this upon it's inhabitants.''

'''Marissa''': ''If what you say is true, repairing our ship may be the least of our worries.''

Part 2:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Commander, your squad fights bravely. This mission's end is within reach.''

'''[[Megatron (ROTF)]]''': ''Broadcast your platitudes and encouragement, misplaced though they are. Regardless of where you're from. I can smell the human stench and Autobot righteousness.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Your appearance is not from our reality...but that voice is unmistakable...MEGATRON!''

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': ''Yes, and it appears the Quintessons have delivered yet another victim for me to destroy. In due time, Prime, in due time.''

Part 3: 

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': S''o, you made it this far? Surprising, given the inherit weakness of your human commander.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If you stand in our way, you will learn the depths of your own weakness...for you shall fall.''

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': ''Save your hollow threats for another time, Autobot. I have other business to tend to. For the time being, why don't you talk to my associate in hate - [[Bonecrusher]]!''

== Chapter 2 - Revelations ==
'''<u>1) In Due Time</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Commander, the missions have been successful in strengthening our base and defenses. Yet, Megatron's mention of the Quintessons has me concerned.''

''He implied they are here. When will they reveal themselves?''

'''Laughter''': ''Hahahaha...ask and you shall receive. Before you stands one of your creators...and future master.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''You may be a creator, but my master you will never be.''

'''Laughter''': ''In due time, Prime. That is, if you manage to survive that which awaits you. Hahahahah!''

Part 2:

'''Laughter''': ''Prime. it's time for you to meet and old friend.''

[[Ironhide|'''Ironhide''']]: ''I may be old, but I'm not sure about friend.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If you are Ironhide, you are a friend.''

'''Ironhide''': ''If you travel with humans, you must be an Optimus. Trouble is, here I don't care who you are.''

''If you keep advancing, you'll face the consequences...me and a whole lotta guns!''

Part 3: 

'''Ironhide''': ''Optimus, you've always lacked the gift of practicality. A practical move would have been to end this mission while you still could.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''The Quintessons have rotted your cerebral circuits. I do not blame you for your misguided words.''

'''Ironhide''': ''Misguided? I think not. Hardened wisdom from one who's seen it all. It's time to get practical!''

'''<u>2) Anger Management</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Rage''': '''''HALT! Where is The Prime?!'''''

'''[[Arcee]]''': That's none of your business. I'm riding shotgun on this mission. Mind telling me who you are?

'''Rage''': '''''Such INSOLENCE! It matters not, though. I, the Quintesson judge, Rage, have placed before you a gauntlet of foes that will silence your INSOLENCE!'''''

'''Arcee''': ''A "gauntlet of foes"? Nice, great way to keep our skills sharp and aim true. And, by the way, there's no need to shout, my auditory sensors work just fine.''

Part 2:

[[Motormaster|'''Motormaster''']]: ''Argh! What is this?! The Quintessons told me to expect a formidable squad of Cybertronians to head my way. And, what do I get?!''

'''Arcee''': ''You get an assassin and a Battle Commander with a squad that's going to teach you...''

'''Motormaster''': '''''TEACH ME WHAT!? A lesson? Impossible!'''''

''You are weak, your human Commander is frail and the so-called squad isn't worthy of my time.''

'''Arcee''': ''I was going to say, "teach you a lesson in...anger management." School will be in session soon.''

Part 3:

'''Arcee''': ''Hey, Motormaster, we're here to help you sort out your anger issues.''

'''Motormaste'''r: ''Really? What took you so long?''

'''Arcee''': ''We wanted to give you some time to get your Stunticons together. They probably could use an attitude adjustment, too.''

'''Motormaster''': ''I don't need The Stunticons to demolish you. When I'm done here, you'll be nothing but a pink pile of scrap metal ready for the junkyard!''

'''<u>3) Don't Go Judging</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Marissa''': Commander, we're sending Mirage with you as an escort of today's mission.

'''[[Mirage]]''': This isn't another test of my loyalty is it? We've been through that before.

'''Marissa''': Of course not, Optimus believes the more of us that can study the terrain, tech, and enemies we face, the better we are able to formulate an effective plan.

'''Mirage''': Good, because you know I'm down for the cause...and I'm even more down for survival!

Part 2: 

'''Judgement''': ''What manner of worthless scrap ventures forth? Or is it worthless too praiseworthy a term for the likes of you?''

'''Mirage''': ''Whoa, stranger. Don't go judging the value of me and my comrades. You don't know us.''

'''Judgement''': ''Judging is by definition what I and my colleagues on The Council of Adjudication do. Your ignorance is outstanding.''

'''Mirage''': ''There you go again. Why don't you enlighten us rather than being so judgemental?''

'''Judgement''': ''Here's all the enlightenment you need for now...you fight, I judge your performance. Now, carry on.''

Part 3:

'''Mirage''': ''Sideswipe, old pal...you're a sight for sore eyes! Surely you haven't succumbed to the Quintesson brain washing.''

'''[[Sideswipe]]''': ''Listen, Mirage, I haven't succumbed to anything except proving that I simply am..the best of the bestest!''

'''Judgement''': ''I'll be the judge of that...''

'''Sideswipe''': ''Judge away! When I'm done with these losers, I'll be wearing a gold medal around my neck and signing a lifetime sponsorship deal with Energex Sports Drink!''

'''<u>4) A Scout No More</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Optimus Prime''': Teletraan has pinpointed an Energon reading with a distinct signature. It's the Bee I faced in combat earlier! 

'''Marissa''': Granted, he was a valuable lieutenant and a trusted friend. But this Bee is different. He's been corrupted somehow.

'''Optimus Prime:''' The histories between these converging realities may differ, but a Bot's true spark doesn't lie, regardless of the reality they are from.

My duty is clear. Bumblebee must be freed from the grip of the Quintessons.

Part 2:

[[Bumblebee (DOTM)|'''Bumblebee (DOTM)''']]: ''So, you've returned for a rematch? Bad call. This time I won't go so easy on you.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Bumblebee...Bee...please listen to what I'm saying. The Quintessons are using you. They're using all of us.''

'''Wisdom''': ''"Using" is such a loaded word. Is it "using" if a bot imbued with such obvious potential grows to become the warrior he was always destined to become?''

'''Bumblebee(DOTM)''': ''The Quintesson speaks the truth. In this reality, I am not a scout cowering in the shadow of the great Prime. Here...I am a warrior!''

Part 3:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Bumblebee! You're better than this. You can be so much more than a pawn in the Quintessons' twisted mind game.''

'''Bumblebee(DOTM)''': ''Don't be so patronizing. You're not my father. I am a sentient being and I enjoy this newfound freedom.''

'''Wisdom''': ''Hahaha, yes, young warrior, taste the freedom. Show Prime and his allies what it means to be free!''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If that is how it transpires, then you shall fall...yet again.''

'''<u>5) Loyalty Points </u>'''

Part 1: 

[[Prowl|'''Prowl''']]: ''Commander, you've run several mission now. Our forces grow, yet the danger grows even more. What manner of world is this?''

'''Death''': ''I can answer that for you. It's a world ruled by your masters and creators...one where you will meet your demise. It is a world called...[[New Quintessa]]!''

'''Prowl''': ''You show your face you floating mechanical squid?!''

'''Death''': ''Yes, and I'll show you more than my face. I'll show you a betrayed comrade seething with vengeance in her spark. I'm off now, but she awaits ahead.''

Part 2:

'''[[Arcee]]''': ''You have some nerve, Prowl!'' 

'''Prowl''': ''Arcee! What are you talking about?''

'''Arcee''': ''I know what you've done! You kidnapped Daniel and are holding hostage back at your base! How could you?!''

'''Prowl''': ''You should know better than to believe that. We've fought side by side on countless missions.''

'''Arcee''': ''Bring him to me or you'll be staring down the barrel of my rifle!''

Part 3:

'''Arcee''': ''Your party stands before me, but I don't see Daniel. It's time for you to pay the price for your betrayal!''

'''Prowl''': ''We've been through this before. The Quintesson's used illusion and deception to test our loyalty before. But we beat them. Search deep in your memory banks...remember!''

'''Arcee''': ''You are loyal to nothing but your twisted version of the Autobot Code. It distorts your sense of decency.''

'''Prowl''': ''You leave us no choice. Perhaps extreme measures will bring you to your senses.''

<nowiki> </nowiki>Part 4:

'''Arcee''': ''Wha..what happened? My casing aches and my circuits are fried.''

'''Prowl''': ''Quintesson mind control and what our human friends call tough love. That's what happened., but fortunately you appear to be shaking off the Quintesson manipulation.''

'''Death''': ''Wishful thinking, Autobot...wishful thinking.''

'''<u>6) The Quintessance</u>'''

Part 1: 

'''Prowl''': ''Commander, a sound strategy to combat the Quintessons requires info. And so far, what we have amounts to a pile of scrap. It's time we changed that.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''Oh really now? How do you propose to do that?''  

'''Prowl''': ''By any means necessary.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''"By any means" ...I hypothesize you mean violence. An associate of yours named Ratchet told me you lack the intellectual capacity to solve problems any other way.'' 

'''Prowl''': ''You have [[Ratchet]]?!'' 

'''Scientist''': ''Oh we have Ratchet...and so much more.'' 

Part 2:  

'''Ratchet''': ''Halt, you protocol pariah!'' 

'''Prowl''': ''Ratchet, friend, my adherence to protocol is what's saving your rusty old undercarriage.'' 

'''Ratchet''': ''Saving me from what? Knowledge? Enlightenment? These Quintessons are light cycles ahead of us in technology and learning.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''Your antiquated medical officer is right. Stand down or I decree that you shall face him in battle.'' 

'''Prowl''': ''Sorry, but I don't follow orders from Quintessons.'' 

Part 3: 

'''Prowl''': ''We've come to end your Age of Enlightenment.'' 

'''Ratchet''': ''Prowl, you don't know what you're doing. This planet is at the forefront of intellectual advancement.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''The ambulance is right. New Quintessa has all the resources to ensure a new Quintesson golden age. The galaxy is entering...a Quintessance, if you will.'' 

'''Prowl''': ''One fueled by Dark Energon? I think not.''  

== Chapter 3 - Shark Attack ==

=== '''1) We'll Need A Bigger Blaster''' ===
Part 1:

'''Judgement''': ''Ah, Commander. We have found your efforts at survival to be entertaining.''

''Before you stands a new challenge. Prepare to encounter our universally feared minions...the [[Sharkticon]]s!''

'''Prowl''': ''Sharkticons? Formidible perhaps, defeatable...absolutely.''

'''Judgement''': ''You seem mistakenly confident. Obviously you've never felt the bite of the Sharkticons before.''

'''Prowl''': ''Maybe, but my pal [[Ultra Magnus]] gave me the lowdown on these horror movie rejects. The Autobots have beat them before and we'll do it again.''

'''Judgement''': ''It was a different time and different place. And, the power of Dark Energon didn't course through the circuitry of The Sharkticons like it does now.''

''You have been warned!''

Part 2:

'''Judgement''': ''Your journey continues, but it is not to late to turn around and spare yourselves.''

'''Prowl''': ''Turn around? Retreat? I follow the Autobot code of conduct...and retreat is nowhere to be found in the code I abide by.''

'''Judgement''': ''Suit yourself. My minions are hungry, and you look to be a suitable meal.''

Part 3: 

'''Death''': ''The Commander and his party of scrap yard rejects stand before us.''

''Judgement, have you reached a verdict? Guilty or innocent?''

'''Prowl''': ''Save your breath. I've seen this routine before. We're innocent...''

'''Judgement''': ''Precisely! Feed them to the Sharkticons!''

=== '''2) Appearing Act''' ===
Part 1:

'''Laughter''': ''I've added someone I suspect is an acquaintance of yours to my gauntlet of pain. He has certain abilities that I have modified and adopted for Quintesson purposes.''

'''Prowl''': ''Quintesson purposes? As far as I can tell you've only got one purpose, and that's being on the receiving end of a beat down.''

'''Scientist''': ''Really? The powers of invisibility and stealth harnessed to unleash ambushes may curb your boastful manners.''

'''Prowl''': ''Invisibility and stealth? [[Mirage]]!''

'''Scientist''': ''A logical deduction. Proceed.''

Part 2:

'''Scientist''': ''I trust you enjoyed your surprise courtesy of the technology I gleaned from your so called colleague.''

'''Mirage''': ''In this new reality, Scientist, I'm not sure anyone is a colleague.''

'''Prowl''': ''Mirage! How could you?''

'''Mirage''': ''With the powers The Quintessons are exercising over us all... how could I not? ''

Part 3:

'''Prowl''': ''Mirage, all those years ago, Cliffjumper was right,. You are a double-crosser.''

'''Mirage''': ''Don't you see Prowl? It's The Quintessons. They compel me to...''

'''Prowl''': ''What I do see is a Cybertronian that aided the enemy with advanced technology.''

'''Mirage''': ''If I can't reason with you, perhaps it's time to drop some invisible box-jitsu on you.''

'''Prowl''': ''"Invisible box-jitsu?" Man, you need to work on your trash-talking skills. Let's do this, traitor!''

=== '''3) Are You Not Entertained?''' ===
'''Death''': ''If it isn't the famed Orion Pax.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''That is a name from the distant past. It no longer applies to who I am today.''

'''Death''': ''Of course, I know that. After all, we created your race. We know well, the history of you and your violent, war torn kind.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If you know our kind, you know we do not seek war. We seek resolutions...and answers to why we are here.''

'''Death''': ''If the mood strikes me, I may enlighten you more...provided you do not perish first.''

Part 2:

'''Death:''' ''You soldier on...a foolhardy if not suicidal strategy.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''It is not foolhardy to face the challenges that stand in the way of one's freedom.''

'''Death''': ''BAH! I am Judge Death! Your insolence assures you the harshest and most permanent of verdicts!''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''"Judge Death?" I have seen worse. When your spark has faced extinguishment as many times as mine, you learn not to fear those like you.''

Part 3: 

'''Death''': ''You've reached your termination, Prime. Your ex-ally [[Ironhide]] shall end your party's journey.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''And if we refuse to fight... ?''

'''Death''': ''Refuse? You can't, it's in your species' spark to fight. We know, we created you.''

''At first we forged your kind to serve us for military and consumer purposes. When we grew bored, you entertained us in gladitorial combat.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''That is ancient history.''

'''Death''': ''Your recent history suggests your Energon lust has not abated. Fight, now, or the might of the Quintessons will exterminate all who remain at your pathetic base.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Very well, for now we shall play your game. Commander, he says we were forged to fight. Show him how we do it.''

=== '''4) It's In Our DNA''' ===
Part 1:

'''Laughter''': ''Megatron, it is time for you to partake in our "games?"''

'''[[Megatron (ROTF)]]''': ''I leave that for the weak willed Autobots and their even weaker Earth Defense Force allies.''

'''Laughter''': ''Your arrogance is equal parts annoying and amusing. Eventually you will fall under Quintesson control and the last laugh will be mine.''

'''Megatron (ROTF)''': ''Hahaha...that is as humorous as Starscream thinking he'll ever be anything other than a second rate tailpipe kisser.''

Part 2:

'''[[Barricade]]''': ''Of course you know, I let you win. That was a study session, nothing more.''

'''[[Marissa Faireborn]]''': ''That's what they all say, especially when they get their butts kicked.''

'''Barricade''': ''Your party contains human and your garb denotes military. Do you serve with that cowardly Autobot and Human alliance NEST?''

'''Marissa''': ''NEST is not of our reality, but if it's humans and Autobots on a mission for freedom, we support the concept. It's kind of what we do.''

'''Barricade''': ''Foolish primitive DNA flesh buckets. You'll be made to suffer when we next meet.''

Part 3:

'''Barricade''': ''Just the party of genetically inferior losers I was looking for.''

'''Marissa''': ''Big talk for a bot that's currently 0-1 and looking to keep your winless record intact.''

'''Barricade''': ''My talk is backed up by a mod specially enhanced based on our last battle. A particularly corrosive fate awaits you.''

=== '''5) Power Seeker''' ===
Part 1:

'''Wisdom''': ''What's this I see before me? Your desperation is evident. You seek aid from a Decepticon of reowned ill repute.''

'''Marissa''': ''Yes, we did use our Spacebridge to call reinforcements.''

''However; the power of The Matrix of Leadership and Soundwave's dedication to logic offset concerns over reputations.''

[[Soundwave|'''Soundwave''']]: ''Quintesson, I have analyzed historical data banks. You have been defeated multiple times before. I calculate that this will be the case again.''

'''Wisdom''': ''You will soon learn that your calculations and logic are indeed very fallible.''

Part 2:

'''[[Starscream]]''': ''Soundwave, why do you and your new-found allies insist upon attacking our hosts?''

'''Soundwave''': ''That is not factual. They are not hosts. They are captors and slave masters. They only use bots for their pleasure.''

'''Starscream''': ''Those are your choice of words. I do not let semantics prevent advantageous relationships from developing.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Advantageous only to you...temporarily. Your logic is inferior.''

Part 3:

'''Soundwave''': ''Starscream, do you continue your pursuit of sycophantic talks with the Quintessons?''

'''Starscream''': ''I speak truth to power.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Incorrect. You speak lies to seek power. Your methods are inferior. The Quintessons will detect your ploy.''

'''Starscream''': ''Silence, you auto-tuned moron! It is time for our hosts to see the power I possess!''

=== '''6) School The Sharks''' ===
Part 1:

'''Rage''': ''For countless cycles, The [[Sharkticon]]s served us well in our travels spreading fear and carrying out our verdicts.''

''Unfortunately, my fellow Quintessons have besmirched the honour of our Sharkticon minions with their ill training and lack of discipline.''

'''[[Grimlock]]''': ''You talk too many words. You waste time. Your story not like Kup's. Be quiet or fight.''

'''Rage''': ''Rest assured, the Sharkticons I have waiting for you will tell you a story you'll never forget.''

Part 2: 

'''Rage''': ''Accept your fate. You are merely pawns, disposable pieces of machinery, here on New Quintessa for our pleasure.''

'''Grimlock''': ''Why you call me a prawn? Me not a shrimp. Grimlock is HUGE. You need to fix your eyes.''

'''Rage''': ''In time my Sharkticon warrior will fix more than just your eyes. He'll fix your attitude, you brain dead hunk of prehistoric metal.''

Part 3: 

'''Sharktion Brawler''': '''ERRRAAAB!'''

'''Rage''': ''Well put my minion. Today you shall feast on Cybertronian miscreants!''

'''Grimlock''': ''Where your army? I see one fish. Me like challenge. Me not like big words with no meaning.''

'''Rage''': ''I see. I need to keep it simple. Sharkticon...ATTACK!''

== Chapter 4 - Under Control ==

=== 1.Voices ===
Part 1:

'''Scientst''': ''The Quintesson council requested that I put your team to a greater test, so a test you shall receive.''

''I've developed a device to vapourize and disperse a particularly powerful strain of Dark Energon we've refined.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Those fortified by the righteous pursuit of freedom shall not succumb to plots of the wicked.''

'''Scientist''': ''Is that so? Perhaps your Cityspeaker ally world suggest otherwise.''

Part 2:

'''[[Windblade]]''': '''''Ahhhhhh! The voices. They're deafening. Can't you hear them?'''''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''The ill effects of the Dark Energon are amplifying your inherent ability to communicate with dormant Titans. You can overcome this. Focus.''

'''Windblade''': ''The voices demand my focus, as well. They compel me to focus on destruction. Yours.''

Part 3:

'''Windblade''': ''They're here!''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Who is here?''

'''Windblade''': ''The spirits of the Titans. They demand retribution for the wars and destruction you have wrought across the galaxies.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Windblade, resist. This is not reality. They are figments of a Dark Energon delusion.''

'''Windblade''': ''You can tell them they are delusions and figments when my blade terminates your ability to function. Vengeance is upon you!''

=== 2. Hold It Down ===
Part 1
* [[Ratchet|'''Ratchet''']]: ''Commander, the effects of this Dark Energon vapor is having a disturbing effect on the bots we encounter.''
* ''Marrisa has sent me with you to take atmospheric samples for analysis.''
* [[Sideswipe|'''Sideswipe''']]: ''Can you guys hold it down? I was catching a little beauty stasis time.''
* '''Ratchet''': ''Sideswipe, I advise you to get back to base.''
* '''Sideswipe''': ''Yeah right, whatever. First I'm going to give my chassis an overhaul and look into buffing out my chrome. This vapor in the air is killing my finish.''
Part 2
* '''Sideswipe''': ''You're back.''
* '''Ratchet''': ''An obvious deduction. I told you to head back to base. You're interfering with my research.''
* '''Sideswipe''': ''And I told you to hold it down. Your "research" sure does involve a lot of clanking, blasting, and exploding.''
* '''Ratchet''': ''Hostiles in the grips of Dark Energon poisoning need to be dealt with.''
* '''Sideswipe''': ''Well, you're making me hostile. All this racket is causing me stress. And stress is bad for my paint job.''
Part 3
* '''Sideswipe:''' ''That's it. You've raised your final ruckus. It's time I sent you back to the seniors' care center.''
* '''Ratchet:''' ''Oooh, that stings. But I'll let it pass, I know it's the Dark Energon talking.''
* '''Sideswipe:''' ''You'll be more than stung when I'm done with you. Just don't scratch the paint job you geriatric meat wagon.''

=== 3. Code Violation ===
Part 1
* '''Wisdom''': ''Once again, your vile transgressors venture forth to bring us entertainment.''
* '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''We fight for our survival, not transgression or entertainment.''
* [[Prowl|'''Prowl''']]''':''' ''Do not deny it. The Quintesson is right. You have committed punishable transgressions. You have violated the Code of Interplanetary Conflict.''
* '''Wisdom:''' ''It seems my enforcer has seen the light of galactic reason. And, what is the punishment for those that violate the code, Prowl?''
* '''Prowl:''' ''Death.''
Part 2
* '''Prowl: '''''In the interest of our shared history. I issue you a warning: proceed further and you will be punished.''
* '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''But in what way do we violate your code?''
* '''Prowl:''' ''The Code of Interplanetary Conflict states clearly that it is illegal to sell or distribute Cybertronian technology.''
* ''Yet, that is precisely what your mission to New Quintessa entails.''
* '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''Our mission was to bring shared human and Autobot technology to Cybertron to breathe life back into your homeland.''
* '''Prowl:''' ''Silence. You indict yourself further by repeating such lies.''
Part 3
* '''Prowl:''' ''You have arrived at your final destination. Your punishment will be swift and sure. Do you have any final statements?''
* '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''The technology we possess is the only thing that's keeping us alive in this nightmare known as New Quintessa. We use it to save ourselves.''
* '''Prowl:''' ''It is too late to save yourselves.''
* '''Marissa Faireborn:''' ''Then we will use it to save you.''

=== 4. The Long Game ===
Part 1
* '''Starscream:''' ''Yet another glorious day amidst the magic that is New Quintessa.''
* '''Laughter:''' ''Hahaha. I find your exuberance to participate in our little gauntlets curious... and amusing, of course.''
* '''Starscream:''' ''Exuberance and resiliency are the foundations of my existence. Your delectable vapors that permeate the air only enhance these traits.''
* '''Laughter:''' ''Word of your conniving flattery is demonstrated with every utterance from your vocal emitter.''
* '''Starscream:''' ''Thank you!''
Part 2
* '''Starscream:''' ''A Cybertronian of great stature approaches. A Quintesson ally in the making?''
* '''Barricade:''' ''Your bright paint job and colorful oratory can't hide your duplicitous ways. It doesn't matter the reality; once a Starscream, always a Starscream.''
* '''Starscream:''' ''But friend, you bear the Decepticon insignia.''
* '''Barricade:''' ''Insignia's are meaningless in this hell I find myself in. The only thing that matters is survival. I've chosen the means of my survival... as apparently, have you.''
Part 3
* '''Laughter:''' A party approaches. Perhaps you can persuade them of the benefits of the New Quintessa lifestyle. Hahahaha.
* '''Starscream:''' It would be my pleasure to pound the virtues of Dark Energon and the Quintesson way into those that require it.
* '''Barricade:''' You're a pathetic joke, Starscream. They use and abuse you, yet you continue to do their bidding.
* '''Starscream:''' I may be a joke to you, but it's a joke you don't get.
* {{RedText|While you battle step by step for your very survival, I play the long game. And a very long game it is.}}

=== 5. Optimum Outcome ===
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: ''Quintessons, your machines test the sanity and courage of my comrades. Know this foul creatures, dread does not fill my spark, only determination to seek freedom.''
* Judgement: Oftentimes, to face one's greatest fear, you have to look no further than the closest mirror. That time for you is now.
* [[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]: Optimus...
* Optimus Prime: ...Prime!
Part 2
* Optimus Prime: You are possessed of the greatness and weight of the Primes. Do not waver from the pursuit of ...
* Optimus Prime (MV1): ...Freedom? Spare me.
* I have seen too much of our own Energon spilled by the humans you align yourself with. They do not deserve my loyalty or protection.
* Optimus Prime: Look about you. The Darkest Hour approaches. We must unite till...
* Optimus Prime (MV1): ...all will never be one.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime (MV1): I have studied the accounts of your reality. Like me, your hubris was the downfall of Cybertron! Unlike me, you have yet to realize the errors of your ways.
* Optimus Prime: My way is sacrifice for the greater good, protection of the innocent, be they Cybertronian or human.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): Traitor! You value the humans over your own kind!
* Optimus Prime: Wrong. I value sentient beings of all kinds.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): I bled for these insects countless times! My spark is extinguished, and driven to the abyss.
* ''It was there where I realized the truth - True victory can only come when you dismiss consequence.''
=== 6. Shackle Me Not ===
Part 1
*Rage: ''Scientist! Explain yourself. The Commander is enroute with a Prime in tow.''
*Scientist: ''What is your point? Many, many Primes have been summoned to New Quintessa to provide us entertainment.''
*Rage: ''BUT this ONE was supposedly under the control of your Vaporizer contraption mere cycles ago! Your technology is in question, your effectiveness as well!''
*Scientist: ''There is no need to shout. Look about you. The air is thick with Dark Energon.''
*Rage: <span style="color:red;">'''''SO?!'''''</span>
*Scientist: ''So wait till you see its effect on my latest pet... Megatron!''
Part 2
*[[Megatron (ROTF)]]: ''The insufferable Quintesson Scientist was right. He predicted your arrival, so here I stand, ready to inflict pain upon the bane of my existence.''
*Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Surely you have help. What of your minions I have seen a uniquely colored Starscream grovelling at the feet of The Quintessons.''
*Megatron (ROTF): ''Lord Megatron needs no help!! The low tech flunk that's been desperately currying favor with The Quintessons is a failure here, just like the Starscream that inhabits our reality was a failure there.''
*Optimus Prime: ''Failure consumes you, and it will again soon enough.''
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: ''I have come to open dialogue with you, as a fellow Cybertronian trapped together in a situation I fear grows dangerous beyond measure.''
*Megatron (ROTF): ''Trapped? I am not trapped. I am merely intrigued.''
*Optimus Prime: ''How can you say that? Can you not survey your surroundings?''
*Megatron (ROTF): ''You always were myopically naive. If you truly worship your precious freedom, then free yourself! Free yourself from the shackles that bind you, be they Quintesson, Autobot...or human.''
*''I have not forgotten what they subjected us to. Neither should you.''

== Chapter 1 - Realities Collide ==
=== 1. ''A Beast to Start'' ===
Part 1
*'''[[Marissa Faireborn]]''': ''Teletraan's scanners have detected a valuable cache of resources.''
*''While we search for Megatron we should continue to upgrade our squad using what we find on our missions.''
Part 2
*'''[[Optimus Prime]]''': ''It seems every bot here has been programmed to do one thing... fight!''
*'''Marissa''': ''Preliminary readings from Teletraan corroborate your assessment.''
* ''Teletraan confirms there are numerous beings of Cybertronian descent in the area, and all show traces of Dark Energon.''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Dark Energon?! The path to our survival grows more perilous indeed.''
Part 3
* '''[[Rhinox]]''': ''I don't know who you are, but I'd advise to slow your roll.''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Stranger, we mean you no harm. We are simply on a mission to gather resources to repair our ship.''
* '''Rhinox''': ''Oh yeah? Well, we got a problem, friend. Resources are scarce and everyone wants 'em.''
* ''You want ''mine''? You're gonna have to talk to my little friends.''
* '''Optimus Prime''': ''Friends?''
* '''Rhinox''': {{RedText|Yeah, I like to call them the Chainguns of Doom!}}

'''1. In With a Boom'''

'''<u>2. A Slow Learner</u>'''

Part 1:
*'''Marissa''': ''Teletraan has plotted two possible courses for the next cache of resources. One path appears to contain formidable combatants likely protecting items of value.''
*'''[[Starscream]]''': ''Or you can take the other "easier" path. Demise at my hands await you either way you choose.''
*'''Optimus Prime''': ''Starscream! Don't you ever learn?''
*'''Starscream''': ''Oh, I've learned lots Autofool! I've learned that the power of Ore-13 has enabled me to do what'' ''Megatron has failed to do time and again...crush you.''
** <u>''...what'' ''Megatron has failed to do... RULE OVER YOU!''</u>
**''<u>As your GLORIOUS King I shall, perhaps, allow you to continue destroying all those in your path.</u>''
*'''Optimus Prime:''' <u>''We do not seek to destroy, Starscream.''</u>
*''<u>We are simply knocking some sense into those whose circuitry has been corrupted and controlled.</u>''
*'''Starscream''': ''<u>Well then I have no room in my story for your pathetic existence, prepare yourself for my reckoning!</u>''

Part 2:

*'''[[Ratchet]]''': ''Commander, We've found repair kits on this planet that could help <u><s>our cause.</s></u> I added one to your inventory <u><s>prior to the mission.</s></u> If needed, I suggest using it before your next battle.''
*'''Starscream''':  ''Yes, "Commander", listen to your antiquated medical officer <u>if you like</u>, but it won't matter. <s>When I'm done with you, Ratchet's famed sick bay will be your FINAL destination!</s> <u>There is no relief from the pain I have planned!</u>''

'''<u>3. Me Have Mod</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Marissa''': ''Commander, [[Prowl]] just got back from surveying the terrain ahead. There's a brewing dust storm of Beta 4'' ''proportions ahead. Through the dust he thought he saw what appeared to be a dinobot.''

'''[[Grimlock]]''': '''''Me no Dinobot. Me Grimlock! King Dinobot!!!'''''

Prowl: Uh-oh, things just took a turn for the dimwitted.

'''Grimlock''': '''''Dumbwhatted? What you mean?! Me smash you...when me ready!'''''

Part 2: 

'''Prowl''': ''I have more intel on Grimlock. He's up ahead, and from what I can gather, he is preparing some sort of object to strengthen his defenses.''

'''Grimlock''': '''''BAAAAAAH!!! Prowl talk too much! But, him right. Me have secret for fight. Me big smart!'''''

'''Prowl''': ''Commander, you take care of the task at hand. I'll investigate his "secret" and report back.''

Part 3: 

'''Prowl''': ''I've got some bad news. King Dimlock has somehow rigged a device that modifies his powers.''

'''Grimlock''': '''''That's right! Me told you me no bozo! Me have mod. You a fleshie with weak bots! BAH! You lose!'''''

'''Prowl''': ''Commander, you distract him in battle. I'll see what I can do about getting this "Mod" tech back to the base for analysis. It could be of use someday.''

'''<u>4. Good Cop Bad Cop</u>'''

Part 1: 

'''Optimus Prime''': ''The urgency of our mission grows great. Teletraan's analysis of our hostile encounters suggest my worst fears my be true.''

''Dark Energon and advanced alien technology are likely behind this madness that has befallen us.''

'''[[Barricade]]''': ''Halt! Are you LadiesMan217?''

'''''I said, are you LADIESMAN217?!'''''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''As I said, madness surrounds us. Commander, roll out!''

Part 2:

'''Prowl''': ''We were able to get a read out on that bot you met back there...the Ladiesman217 Decepticon with more than one screw loose.''

''Teletraan says he's from a parallel reality. And get this, his alt form is a cop car.''

'''Barricade''': ''That's POLICE CAR! I don't know who you are, but I detect Autobot. Let me duly notify you that my job is to make Autobots cease to function...permanently. Proceed if you dare.''

Part 3:

'''Prowl''': ''We're here, It's good cop vs bad cop time.''

'''Barricade''': ''Let me assure you, step a foot forward and it will be bad cop vs dead cop time. And, there's only one bad cop here.''

'''<u>5. The Way Of The Blade</u>'''

Part 1: 

'''[[Windblade]]''': ''This path is not yours to take.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Windblade! We have fought many battles as allies...as friends. What possesses you?''

'''Windblade''': ''It is true I recognize you, Prime. But, here is this insufferable planet, I am compelled to serve a new master - a master that has taught me the ways of...Metallikato!''

'''[[Bludgeon]]''': ''Fools! Enough with the discourse. Windblade, show them the way of the blade!''

Part 2:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Strangers, friends, foes... they all act deranged.''

''Windblade, Grimlock, Bumblebee...it would take an innate knowledge of Cybertronian physiology and mechanics to turn these sparks so dark.''

'''Marissa''': ''Teletraan occurs. The research points towards a technology that is Cybertronian in origin.''

Part 3: 

'''Windblade''': ''Step no further, The first fight was a warning. This will be an ending.''

'''Bludgeon''': ''Windblade! Stand down. You are but a student. Let a master teach them the power of the One True Path.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Decepticon, I respect your dedication to your art. But it is one of darkness. Commander, go forth and show him the light, so that we may find the answers we seek.''

'''<u>6. Hail Who?</u>'''

'''Marissa''': ''We ran diagnostics on the "Mod" Grimlock was using. Teletraan has confirmed what you suspected...The Quintessons are behind it's creation.''

''Mods exist to enhance certain properties of the bot it is connected to.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''As I surmised, our creators - The Quintessons. They would have the capability and desire to inflict a planet such as this upon it's inhabitants.''

'''Marissa''': ''If what you say is true, repairing our ship may be the least of our worries.''

Part 2:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Commander, your squad fights bravely. This mission's end is within reach.''

'''[[Megatron (ROTF)]]''': ''Broadcast your platitudes and encouragement, misplaced though they are. Regardless of where you're from. I can smell the human stench and Autobot righteousness.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Your appearance is not from our reality...but that voice is unmistakable...MEGATRON!''

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': ''Yes, and it appears the Quintessons have delivered yet another victim for me to destroy. In due time, Prime, in due time.''

Part 3: 

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': S''o, you made it this far? Surprising, given the inherit weakness of your human commander.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If you stand in our way, you will learn the depths of your own weakness...for you shall fall.''

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': ''Save your hollow threats for another time, Autobot. I have other business to tend to. For the time being, why don't you talk to my associate in hate - [[Bonecrusher]]!''

==Chapter 2 - Revelations==
'''<u>1) In Due Time</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Commander, the missions have been successful in strengthening our base and defenses. Yet, Megatron's mention of the Quintessons has me concerned.''

''He implied they are here. When will they reveal themselves?''

'''Laughter''': ''Hahahaha...ask and you shall receive. Before you stands one of your creators...and future master.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''You may be a creator, but my master you will never be.''

'''Laughter''': ''In due time, Prime. That is, if you manage to survive that which awaits you. Hahahahah!''

Part 2:

'''Laughter''': ''Prime. it's time for you to meet and old friend.''

'''[[Ironhide]]''': ''I may be old, but I'm not sure about friend.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If you are Ironhide, you are a friend.''

'''Ironhide''': ''If you travel with humans, you must be an Optimus. Trouble is, here I don't care who you are.''

''If you keep advancing, you'll face the consequences...me and a whole lotta guns!''

Part 3: 

'''Ironhide''': ''Optimus, you've always lacked the gift of practicality. A practical move would have been to end this mission while you still could.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''The Quintessons have rotted your cerebral circuits. I do not blame you for your misguided words.''

'''Ironhide''': ''Misguided? I think not. Hardened wisdom from one who's seen it all. It's time to get practical!''

'''<u>2) Anger Management</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Rage''': '''''HALT! Where is The Prime?!'''''

'''[[Arcee]]''': That's none of your business. I'm riding shotgun on this mission. Mind telling me who you are?

'''Rage''': '''''Such INSOLENCE! It matters not, though. I, the Quintesson judge, Rage, have placed before you a gauntlet of foes that will silence your INSOLENCE!'''''

'''Arcee''': ''A "gauntlet of foes"? Nice, great way to keep our skills sharp and aim true. And, by the way, there's no need to shout, my auditory sensors work just fine.''

Part 2:

'''[[Motormaster]]''': ''Argh! What is this?! The Quintessons told me to expect a formidable squad of Cybertronians to head my way. And, what do I get?!''

'''Arcee''': ''You get an assassin and a Battle Commander with a squad that's going to teach you...''

'''Motormaster''': '''''TEACH ME WHAT!? A lesson? Impossible!'''''

''You are weak, your human Commander is frail and the so-called squad isn't worthy of my time.''

'''Arcee''': ''I was going to say, "teach you a lesson in...anger management." School will be in session soon.''

Part 3:

'''Arcee''': ''Hey, Motormaster, we're here to help you sort out your anger issues.''

'''Motormaste'''r: ''Really? What took you so long?''

'''Arcee''': ''We wanted to give you some time to get your Stunticons together. They probably could use an attitude adjustment, too.''

'''Motormaster''': ''I don't need The Stunticons to demolish you. When I'm done here, you'll be nothing but a pink pile of scrap metal ready for the junkyard!''

'''<u>3) Don't Go Judging</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Marissa''': Commander, we're sending Mirage with you as an escort of today's mission.

'''[[Mirage]]''': This isn't another test of my loyalty is it? We've been through that before.

'''Marissa''': Of course not, Optimus believes the more of us that can study the terrain, tech, and enemies we face, the better we are able to formulate an effective plan.

'''Mirage''': Good, because you know I'm down for the cause...and I'm even more down for survival!

Part 2: 

'''Judgement''': ''What manner of worthless scrap ventures forth? Or is it worthless too praiseworthy a term for the likes of you?''

'''Mirage''': ''Whoa, stranger. Don't go judging the value of me and my comrades. You don't know us.''

'''Judgement''': ''Judging is by definition what I and my colleagues on The Council of Adjudication do. Your ignorance is outstanding.''

'''Mirage''': ''There you go again. Why don't you enlighten us rather than being so judgemental?''

'''Judgement''': ''Here's all the enlightenment you need for now...you fight, I judge your performance. Now, carry on.''

Part 3:

'''Mirage''': ''Sideswipe, old pal...you're a sight for sore eyes! Surely you haven't succumbed to the Quintesson brain washing.''

'''[[Sideswipe]]''': ''Listen, Mirage, I haven't succumbed to anything except proving that I simply am..the best of the bestest!''

'''Judgement''': ''I'll be the judge of that...''

'''Sideswipe''': ''Judge away! When I'm done with these losers, I'll be wearing a gold medal around my neck and signing a lifetime sponsorship deal with Energex Sports Drink!''

'''<u>4) A Scout No More</u>'''

Part 1:

'''Optimus Prime''': Teletraan has pinpointed an Energon reading with a distinct signature. It's the Bee I faced in combat earlier! 

'''Marissa''': Granted, he was a valuable lieutenant and a trusted friend. But this Bee is different. He's been corrupted somehow.

'''Optimus Prime:''' The histories between these converging realities may differ, but a Bot's true spark doesn't lie, regardless of the reality they are from.

My duty is clear. Bumblebee must be freed from the grip of the Quintessons.

Part 2:

[[Bumblebee (DOTM)|'''Bumblebee (DOTM)''']]: ''So, you've returned for a rematch? Bad call. This time I won't go so easy on you.''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Bumblebee...Bee...please listen to what I'm saying. The Quintessons are using you. They're using all of us.''

'''Wisdom''': ''"Using" is such a loaded word. Is it "using" if a bot imbued with such obvious potential grows to become the warrior he was always destined to become?''

'''Bumblebee(DOTM)''': ''The Quintesson speaks the truth. In this reality, I am not a scout cowering in the shadow of the great Prime. Here...I am a warrior!''

Part 3:

'''Optimus Prime''': ''Bumblebee! You're better than this. You can be so much more than a pawn in the Quintessons' twisted mind game.''

'''Bumblebee(DOTM)''': ''Don't be so patronizing. You're not my father. I am a sentient being and I enjoy this newfound freedom.''

'''Wisdom''': ''Hahaha, yes, young warrior, taste the freedom. Show Prime and his allies what it means to be free!''

'''Optimus Prime''': ''If that is how it transpires, then you shall fall...yet again.''

'''<u>5) Loyalty Points </u>'''

Part 1: 

'''[[Prowl]]''': ''Commander, you've run several mission now. Our forces grow, yet the danger grows even more. What manner of world is this?''

'''Death''': ''I can answer that for you. It's a world ruled by your masters and creators...one where you will meet your demise. It is a world called...[[New Quintessa]]!''

'''Prowl''': ''You show your face you floating mechanical squid?!''

'''Death''': ''Yes, and I'll show you more than my face. I'll show you a betrayed comrade seething with vengeance in her spark. I'm off now, but she awaits ahead.''

Part 2:

'''[[Arcee]]''': ''You have some nerve, Prowl!'' 

'''Prowl''': ''Arcee! What are you talking about?''

'''Arcee''': ''I know what you've done! You kidnapped Daniel and are holding hostage back at your base! How could you?!''

'''Prowl''': ''You should know better than to believe that. We've fought side by side on countless missions.''

'''Arcee''': ''Bring him to me or you'll be staring down the barrel of my rifle!''

Part 3:

'''Arcee''': ''Your party stands before me, but I don't see Daniel. It's time for you to pay the price for your betrayal!''

'''Prowl''': ''We've been through this before. The Quintesson's used illusion and deception to test our loyalty before. But we beat them. Search deep in your memory banks...remember!''

'''Arcee''': ''You are loyal to nothing but your twisted version of the Autobot Code. It distorts your sense of decency.''

'''Prowl''': ''You leave us no choice. Perhaps extreme measures will bring you to your senses.''

<nowiki> </nowiki>Part 4:

'''Arcee''': ''Wha..what happened? My casing aches and my circuits are fried.''

'''Prowl''': ''Quintesson mind control and what our human friends call tough love. That's what happened., but fortunately you appear to be shaking off the Quintesson manipulation.''

'''Death''': ''Wishful thinking, Autobot...wishful thinking.''

'''<u>6) The Quintessance</u>'''

Part 1: 

'''Prowl''': ''Commander, a sound strategy to combat the Quintessons requires info. And so far, what we have amounts to a pile of scrap. It's time we changed that.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''Oh really now? How do you propose to do that?''  

'''Prowl''': ''By any means necessary.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''"By any means" ...I hypothesize you mean violence. An associate of yours named Ratchet told me you lack the intellectual capacity to solve problems any other way.'' 

'''Prowl''': ''You have [[Ratchet]]?!'' 

'''Scientist''': ''Oh we have Ratchet...and so much more.'' 

Part 2:  

'''Ratchet''': ''Halt, you protocol pariah!'' 

'''Prowl''': ''Ratchet, friend, my adherence to protocol is what's saving your rusty old undercarriage.'' 

'''Ratchet''': ''Saving me from what? Knowledge? Enlightenment? These Quintessons are light cycles ahead of us in technology and learning.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''Your antiquated medical officer is right. Stand down or I decree that you shall face him in battle.'' 

'''Prowl''': ''Sorry, but I don't follow orders from Quintessons.'' 

Part 3: 

'''Prowl''': ''We've come to end your Age of Enlightenment.'' 

'''Ratchet''': ''Prowl, you don't know what you're doing. This planet is at the forefront of intellectual advancement.'' 

'''Scientist''': ''The ambulance is right. New Quintessa has all the resources to ensure a new Quintesson golden age. The galaxy is entering...a Quintessance, if you will.'' 

'''Prowl''': ''One fueled by Dark Energon? I think not.''  

== Chapter 3 - Shark Attack==

==='''1) We'll Need A Bigger Blaster'''===
Part 1:

'''Judgement''': ''Ah, Commander. We have found your efforts at survival to be entertaining.''

''Before you stands a new challenge. Prepare to encounter our universally feared minions...the [[Sharkticon]]s!''

'''Prowl''': ''Sharkticons? Formidible perhaps, defeatable...absolutely.''

'''Judgement''': ''You seem mistakenly confident. Obviously you've never felt the bite of the Sharkticons before.''

'''Prowl''': ''Maybe, but my pal [[Ultra Magnus]] gave me the lowdown on these horror movie rejects. The Autobots have beat them before and we'll do it again.''

'''Judgement''': ''It was a different time and different place. And, the power of Dark Energon didn't course through the circuitry of The Sharkticons like it does now.''

''You have been warned!''

Part 2:

'''Judgement''': ''Your journey continues, but it is not to late to turn around and spare yourselves.''

'''Prowl''': ''Turn around? Retreat? I follow the Autobot code of conduct...and retreat is nowhere to be found in the code I abide by.''

'''Judgement''': ''Suit yourself. My minions are hungry, and you look to be a suitable meal.''

Part 3: 

'''Death''': ''The Commander and his party of scrap yard rejects stand before us.''

''Judgement, have you reached a verdict? Guilty or innocent?''

'''Prowl''': ''Save your breath. I've seen this routine before. We're innocent...''

'''Judgement''': ''Precisely! Feed them to the Sharkticons!''

==='''2) Appearing Act''' ===
Part 1:

'''Laughter''': ''I've added someone I suspect is an acquaintance of yours to my gauntlet of pain. He has certain abilities that I have modified and adopted for Quintesson purposes.''

'''Prowl''': ''Quintesson purposes? As far as I can tell you've only got one purpose, and that's being on the receiving end of a beat down.''

'''Scientist''': ''Really? The powers of invisibility and stealth harnessed to unleash ambushes may curb your boastful manners.''

'''Prowl''': ''Invisibility and stealth? [[Mirage]]!''

'''Scientist''': ''A logical deduction. Proceed.''

Part 2:

'''Scientist''': ''I trust you enjoyed your surprise courtesy of the technology I gleaned from your so called colleague.''

'''Mirage''': ''In this new reality, Scientist, I'm not sure anyone is a colleague.''

'''Prowl''': ''Mirage! How could you?''

'''Mirage''': ''With the powers The Quintessons are exercising over us all... how could I not? ''

Part 3:

'''Prowl''': ''Mirage, all those years ago, Cliffjumper was right,. You are a double-crosser.''

'''Mirage''': ''Don't you see Prowl? It's The Quintessons. They compel me to...''

'''Prowl''': ''What I do see is a Cybertronian that aided the enemy with advanced technology.''

'''Mirage''': ''If I can't reason with you, perhaps it's time to drop some invisible box-jitsu on you.''

'''Prowl''': ''"Invisible box-jitsu?" Man, you need to work on your trash-talking skills. Let's do this, traitor!''

==='''3) Are You Not Entertained?'''===
